heading: About
paragraphs: I'm a fifth-year software engineering student at Epitech, and I mostly work on the backend: APIs, databases and the infrastructure that keeps them running.

On Melo, my end-of-studies project, I'm the backend tech lead and its main developer, building the Go microservices behind the app. I also ship my own projects end to end: this site runs on a server I manage, deployed with Docker and GitHub Actions.
I'm looking for a backend or software engineering internship where I can work on systems that run in production.
